purpose: Distribution targets for eligible AI Showcase projects. This plan chooses the right public channel for each story; it does not prove that a project is released or authorize external posting.

eligibility_policy.rule: A project may not be labeled public_showcase until this matrix has an exact project_targets record naming where its demo materials will be posted, the target status, the artifact, and the active gate. A planned or gated destination is still a known destination; it is not proof that publication has happened.

channel_catalog.label: GitHub
channel_catalog.purpose: Source, release, install, and provenance home for the project.
channel_catalog.gate: The repository, README, release boundary, and linked evidence make the same bounded claim.

channel_catalog.label: Portfolio case page
channel_catalog.purpose: No-auth recruiter-facing demo or case-study page.
channel_catalog.gate: The page is reachable without authentication and keeps preview, copy, and proof within the verified claim boundary.

channel_catalog.label: DEV.to / #showdev
channel_catalog.purpose: Human-written technical case study, build lesson, or project post.
channel_catalog.gate: The post teaches or explains something concrete; it is not a bare promotional link.

channel_catalog.label: daily.dev
channel_catalog.purpose: Direct post or Squad distribution for the substantive developer article.
channel_catalog.gate: Use original, human-authored developer content; do not submit generic AI-generated launch copy or primarily self-promotional material.

channel_catalog.label: Hacker News
channel_catalog.purpose: High-signal technical discussion or Show HN launch.
channel_catalog.gate: Use Show HN only when people can try the non-trivial project with minimal friction; otherwise make a regular submission. Never coordinate votes.

channel_catalog.label: Product Hunt
channel_catalog.purpose: Launch channel for a polished, user-facing product with a live demo.
channel_catalog.gate: The product is genuinely explorable, the maker story is ready, and the launch is not just a library, landing page, or internal tool.

channel_catalog.label: Indie Hackers
channel_catalog.purpose: Build-in-public updates, product lessons, and founder-oriented discussion.
channel_catalog.gate: Share the journey, tradeoffs, and feedback sought rather than duplicating a launch advertisement.

channel_catalog.label: Targeted Reddit community
channel_catalog.purpose: Domain-specific feedback from a community that has a real reason to care.
channel_catalog.gate: Read the subreddit rules, participate authentically, disclose authorship, and tailor one post to that community.

channel_catalog.label: LinkedIn
channel_catalog.purpose: Result-focused career signal tied to a role or technical capability.
channel_catalog.gate: Lead with the outcome, evidence, and lesson; link to the canonical case page rather than making the post the archive.

channel_catalog.label: Handshake
channel_catalog.purpose: Career-facing project entry and AI Showcase submission.
channel_catalog.gate: The preview, short description, public proof link, and AI/human role boundary satisfy the reviewed Handshake material bar.

channel_catalog.label: X / Bluesky
channel_catalog.purpose: Short discovery amplifier for a canonical case study or launch.
channel_catalog.gate: Use a concise thread or release note that points back to the durable canonical page.
